texts: Selective coronary angiography is not required before repair of PA-VSD with MAPCAs: E.
Catheterization must show the true pulmonary arteries, the origin, course and stenoses of every collateral and which lung segments each one supplies, and the pressures.
When the true pulmonary arteries do not fill, pulmonary venous wedge angiography can light them up from the other side.
The coronary arteries are usually normal and are seen well enough on the aortogram and by echocardiography.
In the picture, every path is charted and the hidden money pipes are lit from the veins, while the camera for the green crown is put away.
Memory hook: map every path and find the hidden pipes; the crown can wait.
